d: The 2026 US Midterms delivered a historic Democratic victory, flipping Republican strongholds across Texas, Ohio, Iowa, Kansas and South Carolina and handing Donald Trump and the GOP a major setback. Despite Elon Musk pouring at least $458 million into Republican campaigns through America PAC, several candidates he backed suffered defeats, raising questions about the influence of billionaire money in American politics. Women voters, the economy, democracy, immigration, healthcare, foreign policy, the Iran war and anti-Indian rhetoric shaped the election. As Democrats seized control of both…
